evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Creates the core game entity; no missing prerequisite capability is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... estimates that have been given even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This read behavior exposes a missing necessary creation capability: there is no story allowing an estimator to submit or select a card/estimate. Without that, estimates can never be created, so the application flow is incomplete.
